### Backend Comparison: Python vs Rust

Canary rollout status and per-backend performance comparison for the controller I/O pipeline.

-----

1.title: Controllers on Python
1.query: timeseries count = count(controller_backend_info), filter:{backend == "python"}, by:{serial} | summarize total = countIf(arrayLast(count) > 0)

2.title: Controllers on Rust
2.query: timeseries count = count(controller_backend_info), filter:{backend == "rust"}, by:{serial} | summarize total = countIf(arrayLast(count) > 0)

3.title: Canary Rollout %
3.description: Percentage of controllers on Rust backend
3.query: timeseries rust = count(controller_backend_info), filter:{backend == "rust"}, by:{serial} | summarize rustCount = count() | lookup [timeseries count(controller_backend_info), filter:{backend != "mock"}, by:{serial} | summarize totalCount = count()], sourceField:, lookupField: | fieldsAdd pct = rustCount / totalCount * 100 | fields pct

5.title: Pipeline CPU (Stacked)
5.description: Combined CPU cost of controller-manager + python-hid + rust-hid
5.query: timeseries avg(process_cpu_seconds_total, rate: 5m), by:{service.name}, filter:{service.name IN ("controller-manager-service", "python-hid", "rust-hid")}

6.title: Pipeline Memory (Stacked)
6.description: Combined resident memory of controller-manager + python-hid + rust-hid

7.title: Pipeline Threads
7.description: Thread count for controller-manager, python-hid, and rust-hid

9.title: Input Lag by Backend
9.description: p95 input lag split by backend type
9.query: timeseries percentile(controller_input_lag_seconds, 95), by:{serial} | lookup [timeseries count(controller_backend_info), by:{serial, backend}], sourceField:serial, lookupField:serial | fieldsAdd backend | summarize p95 = avg(arrayLast(`percentile(controller_input_lag_seconds, 95)`)), by:{backend}

10.title: Update Frequency by Backend
10.description: Controller update rate (Hz) split by backend
10.query: timeseries avg(controller_state_update_hz), by:{serial} | lookup [timeseries count(controller_backend_info), by:{serial, backend}], sourceField:serial, lookupField:serial | fieldsAdd backend | summarize avgHz = avg(arrayLast(`avg(controller_state_update_hz)`)), by:{backend}

12.title: Poll Drops by Backend
12.description: Poll drop rate split by backend type
12.query: timeseries sum(controller_poll_drops_total, rate: 1m), by:{serial} | lookup [timeseries count(controller_backend_info), by:{serial, backend}], sourceField:serial, lookupField:serial | fieldsAdd backend | summarize drops = sum(arrayLast(`sum(controller_poll_drops_total)`)), by:{backend}

13.title: Disconnects by Backend
13.description: Controller disconnect rate split by backend type
13.query: timeseries sum(controller_disconnect_total, rate: 1m), by:{serial} | lookup [timeseries count(controller_backend_info), by:{serial, backend}], sourceField:serial, lookupField:serial | fieldsAdd backend | summarize disconnects = sum(arrayLast(`sum(controller_disconnect_total)`)), by:{backend}
